name: quoxslots
tagline: A durable address for every session.
description: A fixed pool of named slots that ephemeral agent sessions check out and release. You talk to the slot, not to whichever session happens to be holding it, so a handover never costs you the thread. Each slot has its own chat thread, renders into a bridged chat app, and every action is witnessed. When a session dies its slot goes stale and frees itself, so a crash never wedges an address.
shortDescription: Durable named addresses for ephemeral agent sessions
author: QUOX
_pricingNote: PROVISIONAL. DEVSUITE plan keeps bundle SKU + final pricing owner-gated; this figure exists so the manifest is well-formed and the plugin can be enabled, not as an approved price.
dashboardSurfaceNote: No standalone route by design: Slots is a tab on /dev-suite (/dev-suite?tab=slots).
evidenceExemptNote: A heartbeat is a high-frequency liveness ping, not a governed action. Witnessing every one would write an envelope per held slot per interval and flood the evidence store: exactly the unbounded volt.db growth that reached 89GB and had to be bounded on 2026-08-19. The state CHANGES a heartbeat causes (held to stale, stale to free) are witnessed by the sweep, which is the auditable event. Deliberate, not an oversight.
marketingPoints: Address the work, not the process: a slot outlives every session that holds it
Steer a working session from your phone through a bridged chat thread
A crashed session never wedges a slot: heartbeats lapse, the slot goes stale, then frees itself
Assign a slot to a session name and it claims the slot when it starts
Every checkout, release and message witnessed and classified
Same verbs in the terminal and the dashboard, one for one

durableAddress.name: Durable named addresses
durableAddress.description: An org-scoped pool of slots that exist whether or not anything holds them, the way a desk exists between shifts.

checkoutLifecycle.name: Checkout, heartbeat, reap
checkoutLifecycle.description: Sessions borrow a slot and heartbeat while they work. A lapsed heartbeat marks the slot stale and it frees itself rather than staying locked forever.

bridgedThreads.name: Reachable from your phone
bridgedThreads.description: Each slot's thread renders into a bridged chat app, and a reply addressed to the slot is delivered to whichever session holds it. Bridge rooms are verified before they are stored, so a wrong room is refused rather than rendering to nobody.

witnessedActions.name: Witnessed by default
witnessedActions.description: Create, assign, checkout, release, retire and say each emit a classified envelope, with retiring a slot rated higher risk than reading one.
